## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      10 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 16 jun 2026 - 22 ago 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _suzicatherine_, 19 ago 2026, 1/5: "Harder to use and regularly freezes since the recent update. The whole point is that I should not have to focus on what I’m doing - not think about the app & deal with it crashing. Counterproductive."
            2. _TDTW!_, 17 ago 2026, 1/5: "The 2026 redesign is clearly meant to promote the paid subscription model and not for ergonomics. The post-session is now multiple screens showing among other unhelpful analytics the option to watch ads to boost reward. The new interface is buggy, slow, bloated, and often unresponsive. Useful features (e.g. adjusting focus time) are hidden behind unnecessary menus. The pay-to-unlock trees are background noise, but you can't ignore the constant nagging to watch ads or pay. The old interface was good precisely because it's minimalistic. I hope paid users can have the option to revert to the old interface. For other frustrated users: you can still use the interface if you turn on plant together. Apparently this feature will be removed once the new interface officially launches. I hope the developers have the decency to leave it in."
            3. _Manthan Parmar_, 16 ago 2026, 1/5: "I don't know why the app is so lagging since a long time and the makers are doing nothing also this latest update is the worst update I had ever seen, multiple skips till to reach the home page every single time.. useless enginners"
